$comment: Single source of truth for the integration tests in test/integration/. The bump script (script/test/refresh-integration-snapshot.sh) regenerates everything below. Adding or removing a test account is a JSON edit only — see docs/howto/refresh-integration-test-blocks.md.
$tolerance_comment: Max relative drift allowed between forge-computed NAV and Debank's USD total at bump time. 0.01 = 1%.
$supportedDebankProtocols_comment: Debank protocol id allowlist per chain. The bump script filters /v1/user/all_complex_protocol_list by (chain matches debankChainId) AND (id with chain prefix stripped ∈ list). Stored as the short id (no chain prefix) — Debank uses bare ids on mainnet and `<chain>_<id>` elsewhere; the script normalises both. Add a new entry whenever a balance adapter is added for a protocol Debank covers; if Debank doesn't cover the protocol, add nothing and accept that NAV will exceed filtered-Debank by that position's value.
